# opnsense_haproxy_acl (Resource)

HAProxy conditions (**Services ▸ HAProxy ▸ Settings ▸ Rules & Checks ▸ Conditions**, plugin `os-haproxy`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "opnsense_haproxy_acl" "api_host" {
  name       = "api-host"
  expression = "hdr"
  hdr        = "api.example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

- `name` (String) Name to identify this condition.

### Optional

- `allowed_groups` (Set of String) Allowed Groups. Defaults to `[]`.
- `allowed_users` (Set of String) Allowed Users. Defaults to `[]`.
- `case_sensitive` (Boolean) Enable to make the condition case-sensitive (if applicable). By default all conditions are not case-sensitive. Defaults to `false`.
- `converter` (String) Transforms or processes the output of a sample fetch (e.g. variable, mapping, arithmetic, string manipulation) and passes the result to the next converter or final evaluation. Make more complex conditions possible, e.g. acl rate_abuse var(req.rate_limit),sub(req.request_rate) lt 0. Defaults to ``.

- `src_http_fail_cnt` (Number) Value. Defaults to `-1` (OPNsense default).
- `src_http_fail_cnt_comparison` (String) Comparison. One of `gt`, `ge`, `eq`, `lt`, `le`. Defaults to `gt`.
- `src_http_fail_rate` (Number) Value. Defaults to `-1` (OPNsense default).
- `src_http_fail_rate_comparison` (String) Comparison. One of `gt`, `ge`, `eq`, `lt`, `le`. Defaults to `gt`.
- `src_http_req_cnt` (Number) The cumulative number of HTTP requests from the incoming connection's source address. Defaults to `-1` (OPNsense default).
- `src_http_req_cnt_comparison` (String) Comparison. One of `gt`, `ge`, `eq`, `lt`, `le`. Defaults to `gt`.
- `src_http_req_rate` (Number) The average rate of HTTP requests from the incoming connection's source address. Defaults to `-1` (OPNsense default).
- `src_http_req_rate_comparison` (String) Comparison. One of `gt`, `ge`, `eq`, `lt`, `le`. Defaults to `gt`.
- `src_inc_gpc` (Number) Value. Defaults to `-1` (OPNsense default).
- `src_inc_gpc0` (Number) Value. Defaults to `-1` (OPNsense default).
- `src_inc_gpc0_comparison` (String) Comparison. One of `gt`, `ge`, `eq`, `lt`, `le`. Defaults to `gt`.
- `src_inc_gpc1` (Number) Value. Defaults to `-1` (OPNsense default).
- `src_inc_gpc1_comparison` (String) Comparison. One of `gt`, `ge`, `eq`, `lt`, `le`. Defaults to `gt`.
- `src_inc_gpc_comparison` (String) Comparison. One of `gt`, `ge`, `eq`, `lt`, `le`. Defaults to `gt`.
- `src_kbytes_in` (Number) The total amount of data received from the incoming connection's source address (in kilobytes). Defaults to `-1` (OPNsense default).
- `src_kbytes_in_comparison` (String) Comparison. One of `gt`, `ge`, `eq`, `lt`, `le`. Defaults to `gt`.
- `src_kbytes_out` (Number) The total amount of data sent to the incoming connection's source address (in kilobytes). Defaults to `-1` (OPNsense default).
- `src_kbytes_out_comparison` (String) Comparison. One of `gt`, `ge`, `eq`, `lt`, `le`. Defaults to `gt`.
- `src_port` (Number) An integer value corresponding to the TCP source port of the connection on the client side, which is the port the client connected from. Defaults to `-1` (OPNsense default).
- `src_port_comparison` (String) Comparison. One of `gt`, `ge`, `eq`, `lt`, `le`. Defaults to `gt`.
- `src_sess_cnt` (Number) The cumulative number of connections initiated from the incoming connection's source address. Defaults to `-1` (OPNsense default).
- `src_sess_cnt_comparison` (String) Comparison. One of `gt`, `ge`, `eq`, `lt`, `le`. Defaults to `gt`.
- `src_sess_rate` (Number) src_sess_rate. Defaults to `-1` (OPNsense default).
- `src_sess_rate_comparison` (String) src_sess_rate_comparison. One of `gt`, `ge`, `eq`, `lt`, `le`. Defaults to `gt`.
- `ssl_c_ca_commonname` (String) Verify the CA Common-Name of the certificate presented by the client against the specified string. Defaults to ``.
- `ssl_c_verify_code` (Number) Specify the SSL/TLS error ID that should be checked for the incoming connection. Please refer to your SSL library's documentation for an exhaustive list of error codes. Defaults to `-1` (OPNsense default).
- `ssl_fc_sni` (String) The value of the Server Name TLS extension sent by a client matches the exact string. Defaults to ``.
- `ssl_hello_type` (String) An integer value containing the type of the SSL hello message found in the request buffer if the buffer contains data that parse as a complete SSL (v3 or superior) client hello message. One of `x0`, `x1`, `x2`. Defaults to `x1`.
- `ssl_sni` (String) The value of the Server Name TLS extension sent by a client matches the exact string. Defaults to ``.
- `ssl_sni_beg` (String) The value of the Server Name TLS extension sent by a client starts with the specified string (prefix match). Defaults to ``.
- `ssl_sni_end` (String) The value of the Server Name TLS extension sent by a client ends with the specified string (suffix match). Defaults to ``.
- `ssl_sni_reg` (String) The value of the Server Name TLS extension sent by a client matches with the specified regular expression. Defaults to ``.
- `ssl_sni_sub` (String) The value of the Server Name TLS extension sent by a client contains the specified string (substring match). Defaults to ``.
- `table_name` (String) Specifies the name of a stick-table that will be used for key lookups. This is usually the name of the backend/frontend where the stick-stable is configured. When nothing is specified, the stick-table of the current backend/frontend will be used. Defaults to ``.
- `url_param` (String) Specify the URL parameter to be checked for the value specified below. Defaults to ``.
- `url_param_value` (String) Specify the value for the URL parameter. Defaults to ``.
- `urlparam` (String) urlparam. Defaults to ``.
- `value` (String) value. Defaults to ``.
- `var` (String) The name of a variable, followed by an optional default value, e.g. (req.rate_limit) or (req.rate_limit,10). Defaults to ``.
- `var_comparison` (String) Comparison. One of `gt`, `ge`, `eq`, `lt`, `le`. Defaults to `gt`.
- `var_value` (String) Value. Defaults to ``.

- `id` (String) UUID of the condition.
